title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Planner Agent for planning and managing work
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licence requirement, PowerShell restrictions and organisation-wide block are supported. One minor clarification should acknowledge that the Planner admin overview now calls basic plans unified plans.

claims.claim: Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot helps users plan, organise and manage work.
claims.quote: Planner agent in Microsoft 365 will help you plan, organize, and manage work more efficiently.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Planner Agent is an included capability of the Microsoft Copilot licence.

claims.where: summary; licensing.notes; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Users need a Microsoft Copilot licence to access Planner Agent in Planner.
claims.quote:
Users must have the following license to access Planner Agent in Planner:
- A Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The cited Planner admin and turn-off pages do not state a separate Planner Agent purchase or price.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner Agent Microsoft 365 Copilot pricing meter credits licence included; opened planner/planner-for-admins and planner/turn-off-planner-agent. Both describe Copilot entitlement; neither lists a separate Planner Agent purchase or price.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated this Planner Agent's tenant arrival default in Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent" "Copilot" "default"; Planner Agent Microsoft Copilot default enabled availability admin switch. Opened Planner turn-off/admin pages, Manage agents and Copilot privacy. Agent management defaults and user activation do not state this agent's arrival default.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false turns off Planner Agent and its chat for all users in Planner.
claims.quote:
To turn off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false

claims.claim: An admin UI for the Planner-specific AllowPlannerCopilot and security-group restriction is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner" "AllowPlannerCopilot" "admin center"; Planner Agent Microsoft Copilot default enabled availability admin switch Planner AllowPlannerCopilot admin UI. Read Planner turn-off/admin pages and Teams app-management results; no UI for these Planner-specific settings.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block reaches the organisation-wide agent block.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > All agents.
In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents.
In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.

claims.claim: POST /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.claim: The Planner group restriction is set with -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId.
claims.quote:
To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>
